title: Apple and cinnamon porridge
description: Creamy oats cooked in milk with grated apple, cinnamon and a few walnuts on top.
steps: Put the oats and milk in a small pot and bring to a gentle simmer on medium heat.

steps.text: Turn the heat to low and cook for 5 minutes, stirring often, until creamy.
steps.tip: Stirring often makes it creamy and stops it sticking. Add a splash of water if it gets too thick.

steps: Meanwhile chop the walnuts roughly and grate the apple, skin on, around the core.
Stir the apple and cinnamon into the porridge and cook 2 minutes more.
Spoon into bowls and top with the walnuts and a little honey.

title: Banana oat pancakes
description: Three-ingredient pancakes from banana, eggs and oats, served with yogurt and berries.

steps.text: Blend the bananas, eggs and oats into a thick batter, or mash the bananas well with a fork and mix in the eggs and oats.
steps.tip: Let the batter stand for a few minutes so the oats soften and thicken it.

steps: Put the berries in a small pan on low heat to thaw and warm, stirring now and then.
Heat a little of the butter in a non-stick frying pan on medium-low. Add spoonfuls of batter to make small pancakes, about 8 cm across.

steps.text: Cook for 2 minutes until bubbles appear and the edges set, then flip and cook 2 minutes more. Repeat with the rest.
steps.tip: Keep them small and the heat gentle: they have no flour, so big ones break when you flip them.

steps: Serve with a spoon of yogurt and the warm berries.

title: Scrambled eggs on toast
description: Soft, slow-scrambled eggs on wholegrain toast with sliced tomato.
steps: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add the salt and pepper and beat with a fork until smooth. Slice the tomato.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan on low heat. Pour in the eggs and leave them for a few seconds.

steps.text: Stir slowly with a spatula, pushing the eggs from the edges to the middle, for 3 to 4 minutes until soft curds form. Toast the bread meanwhile.
steps.tip: Low heat and slow stirring make creamy eggs. Take them off while they still look a little wet: they finish cooking in their own heat.

steps: Spoon the eggs onto the toast and serve with the sliced tomato.

title: Vegetable omelette
description: A folded omelette with pepper, spinach and onion and a little cheese.
steps: Dice the pepper, slice the spring onion and grate the cheese. Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan on medium. Fry the pepper and spring onion for 3 minutes, then add the spinach and stir until it wilts.
Spread the vegetables out, pour in the eggs and let them sit for a few seconds. Gently pull the set edges into the middle with a spatula, tilting the pan so the runny egg fills the gaps.

steps.text: When the omelette is almost set but still a little wet on top, after about 2 minutes, scatter over the cheese.
steps.tip: It keeps cooking after you fold it, so do not wait until the top is dry.

steps: Fold it in half, cut it in two and serve with bread.

title: Greek yogurt with honey, walnuts and fruit
description: Thick yogurt with a drizzle of honey, toasted walnuts and a sliced pear or apple.

steps.text: If you like, toast the oats and walnuts in a dry frying pan on medium heat for 2 minutes, shaking the pan, until they smell nutty.
steps.tip: Tip them out of the pan straight away, or they keep cooking and burn.

steps: Chop the walnuts roughly. Core the pear and slice it.
Spoon the yogurt into bowls and top with the pear, walnuts and oats.
Drizzle with the honey.

title: Chia pudding with berries
description: Chia seeds soaked overnight in milk with vanilla, topped with berries. Make it the evening before.
steps: Put the chia, milk and honey in two jars and stir well.

steps.text: Wait 10 minutes and stir again, breaking up any clumps.
steps.tip: This second stir matters. Without it the seeds clump at the bottom.

steps: Close the jars and leave them in the fridge overnight.
In the morning, thaw or gently warm the berries, chop the almonds and put both on top.

title: Berry smoothie bowl
description: A thick frozen berry and banana smoothie in a bowl, topped with oats, seeds and fruit.
steps: Peel the bananas. Put the frozen berries, one banana and the yogurt in a blender.

steps.text: Blend until thick and smooth, stopping to scrape down the sides.
steps.tip: It should be thicker than a smoothie, like soft ice cream. Add only a little milk if the blender gets stuck.

steps: Slice the other banana.
Pour into bowls and top with the banana slices, oats and pumpkin seeds. Eat straight away.

title: Avocado toast with a soft egg
description: Crushed avocado with lemon and chili on toast, topped with a soft-boiled egg.

steps.text: Bring a small pot of water to the boil. Lower in the eggs gently with a spoon and boil for 6.5 minutes.
steps.tip: This gives a set white and a soft, jammy yolk. For a firm yolk, boil them about 9 minutes.

steps: Lift the eggs into a bowl of cold water and leave them for 2 minutes so they are easy to peel.

steps.text: Meanwhile halve the avocado, remove the stone and scoop the flesh into a bowl. Mash it with a fork with the lemon juice, salt and chili flakes.
steps.tip: A ripe avocado gives a little when you press near the stem. Leave the mash a bit chunky.

steps: Toast the bread. Peel the eggs and cut them in half.
Spread the avocado thickly on the toast and put the egg halves on top, with another tiny pinch of salt on the yolks.

title: Cottage cheese and tomato toast
description: Fresh cottage cheese on toast with tomato, cucumber, a little olive oil and black pepper.
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Slice the tomato and cucumber thinly.
Spread the cottage cheese thickly on the toast and lay the tomato and cucumber on top.

steps.text: Drizzle with the olive oil and finish with black pepper and a pinch of salt.
steps.tip: A little dried oregano or chopped chives on top is good too.

title: French toast with berries
description: Bread soaked in egg and milk, fried golden and served with warm berries and yogurt.
steps: Put the berries in a small pan on low heat to thaw and warm, stirring now and then, about 5 minutes.
Whisk the eggs, milk and cinnamon in a wide, shallow dish.

steps.text: Heat half the butter in a frying pan on medium heat. Dip a slice of bread in the egg for a few seconds on each side, let the extra drip off and put it in the pan.
steps.tip: Day-old bread is best. Fresh bread soaks up too much and falls apart.

steps.text: Fry for 2 to 3 minutes on each side until golden. Repeat with the rest, adding the rest of the butter.
steps.tip: If the outside browns before the middle is set, turn the heat down a little.

steps: Serve the toast with the warm berries and a spoon of yogurt.

title: Bircher muesli
description: Oats soaked overnight in yogurt and milk with grated apple, raisins and hazelnuts.

steps.text: The evening before, grate the apple, skin on, into a bowl.
steps.tip: Mix it with the yogurt straight away so it does not go brown.

steps: Add the oats, yogurt, milk and raisins and stir well. Cover and put it in the fridge overnight.

steps.text: In the morning, chop the hazelnuts roughly. If you like, toast them in a dry pan on medium heat for 3 minutes, shaking the pan.
steps.tip: Toasted hazelnuts taste much nuttier. Take them off when they smell toasty and start to brown.

steps: Stir the muesli, add a splash of milk if it is too thick, and top with the hazelnuts.

title: Breakfast burrito
description: Scrambled eggs, beans, peppers and cheese wrapped in a warm tortilla. Good to take away.
steps: Dice the pepper, drain and rinse the beans and grate the cheese. Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat the oil in a frying pan on medium and fry the pepper for 3 minutes. Add the beans and warm them for 2 minutes.

steps.text: Turn the heat to low, pour in the eggs and stir slowly until just set, about 2 minutes.
steps.tip: Take them off while still a little wet: they keep cooking inside the burrito.

steps: Warm the tortillas for a few seconds in a dry pan so they fold without cracking.

steps.text: Spoon the eggs and beans down the middle of each tortilla, add the cheese and salsa, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
steps.tip: Toasting the rolled burrito seam side down in the dry pan seals it. Wrap it in foil to take with you.

title: Ham and cheese toastie
description: Crisp toasted sandwich with ham and melted cheese, served with a few slices of cucumber.
steps: Slice the cheese thinly, or grate it so it melts faster.

steps.text: Cover half the slices of bread with ham and cheese and put the other slices on top. Spread the butter thinly on the outsides.
steps.tip: Butter on the outside, not inside, is what makes the crust golden and crisp.

steps.text: Heat a frying pan on medium-low. Put in the sandwiches, press down with a spatula and cook for 3 minutes until golden underneath.
steps.tip: Low heat gives the cheese time to melt before the bread burns. A sandwich maker works too: 3 to 4 minutes, closed.

steps: Flip them and cook the other side for 2 to 3 minutes, pressing again, until golden and the cheese starts to melt out at the edges.
Cut them diagonally and serve with cucumber slices on the side.

title: Peanut butter and banana toast
description: Wholegrain toast with peanut butter, sliced banana and a sprinkle of cinnamon.
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Spread the peanut butter on the toast while it is still warm, so it softens and spreads easily.

steps.text: Peel the banana, slice it into rounds and lay them on top.
steps.tip: A ripe banana with a few brown spots is the sweetest.

steps: Sprinkle with a pinch of cinnamon and serve with a glass of milk each.

title: Kajgana with peppers and onion
description: Croatian-style scrambled eggs cooked with sweet pepper, onion and a little bacon, with fresh bread.
steps: Cut the pepper into thin strips, slice the onion and dice the bacon. Beat the eggs with the salt in a bowl.

steps.text: Heat the oil in a frying pan on medium. Fry the bacon, onion and pepper for 6 minutes, stirring, until soft and lightly browned.
steps.tip: For a vegetarian version, leave out the bacon and fry the vegetables in a little more oil.

steps: Turn the heat to low and pour in the eggs. Let them sit for a few seconds, then stir slowly, folding from the edges to the middle.

steps.text: Take the pan off the heat while the eggs still look slightly wet, after about 2 minutes.
steps.tip: Kajgana should be soft and creamy. The eggs keep cooking in the hot pan for a moment.

steps: Serve straight away with bread.

title: Žganci with yogurt
description: Old-fashioned breakfast of crumbly cornmeal žganci with cold yogurt or warm milk.

steps.text: Bring {500 ml} water with the salt to the boil in a medium pot with a lid.
steps.tip: A pot with a heavy base helps: the cornmeal sits on the bottom for a while and should not burn.

steps.text: Pour all the cornmeal (polenta) into the middle of the boiling water in one go. Do not stir. It forms a mound in the water.
steps.tip: Not stirring is the trick for žganci: the mound cooks from the outside in and later breaks into crumbs instead of turning into smooth polenta.

steps.text: Push the handle of a wooden spoon into the middle of the mound, right down to the bottom, to make a hole. Turn the heat to low, half cover the pot and cook for 15 minutes.
steps.tip: The hole lets the water bubble up through the middle so the inside cooks too. Small bubbles are enough.

steps.text: Carefully pour most of the cooking water into a cup and keep it. Break the cornmeal into small crumbs with a fork or wooden spoon, scraping the bottom of the pot.
steps.tip: If it still looks wet and doughy, keep it on low heat for another minute while you break it up.

steps.text: Add the butter, stir it through the crumbs and put the lid on. Leave on the lowest heat for 5 minutes so the crumbs dry out a little.
steps.tip: Too dry or hard? Sprinkle back a spoon or two of the cooking water. They are ready when the crumbs are separate, soft and a little shiny.

steps.text: Spoon the žganci into bowls and serve with the cold yogurt on the side or poured over.
steps.tip: The traditional way: a spoon of warm žganci, then a sip of cold yogurt.

title: Semolina porridge with cocoa
description: Smooth semolina cooked in milk, sprinkled with cocoa and a little sugar. A childhood classic.

steps.text: Take the berries out of the freezer to thaw a little. Pour the milk into a pot and warm it on medium heat until small bubbles appear at the edge, about 4 minutes.
steps.tip: Stay close: milk boils over quickly. Stir now and then so it does not catch on the bottom.

steps.text: Turn the heat to low. Pour in the semolina in a thin stream while whisking all the time.
steps.tip: Pouring slowly and whisking stops lumps. If a few form, press them against the side of the pot.

steps.text: Keep stirring on low heat for 5 minutes until thick and creamy, like a soft pudding.
steps.tip: It thickens more as it cools. If it gets too thick, stir in a splash of milk.

steps: Spoon into bowls. Mix the sugar and cocoa and sprinkle it over the top, or top with the berries.

title: Buckwheat porridge with apple and kefir
description: Nutty buckwheat simmered until soft, with stewed apple, cinnamon and a pour of kefir.

steps.text: Rinse the buckwheat in a sieve. Put it in a small pot with {300 ml} water and a pinch of salt and bring to the boil.
steps.tip: Toasted buckwheat (dark brown) tastes nuttier; raw (pale green) is milder. Both work.

steps.text: Turn the heat to low, cover and simmer for 12 minutes until the grains are soft and the water is gone.
steps.tip: If the water is gone before it is soft, add a splash more.

steps: Meanwhile core and dice the apple. Stir it in with the cinnamon for the last few minutes.
Spoon into bowls and pour over the kefir. Drizzle with a little honey.

title: Savoury oats with spinach and egg
description: Oats cooked like a risotto with stock and spinach, topped with a fried egg and cheese.
steps: Bring {350 ml} water to the boil in a small pot and crumble in the stock cube. Stir in the oats.

steps.text: Turn the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
steps.tip: Like risotto, it should be loose enough to spread on the plate. Add a splash of water if it gets stiff.

steps: Stir in the spinach until it wilts, then cover and take off the heat.
Heat the oil in a frying pan on medium and fry the eggs for 3 to 4 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks still runny.

steps.text: Spoon the oats into bowls, put an egg on each and grate over the parmesan.
steps.tip: Break the yolk into the oats. It makes a rich sauce.

title: Kefir, banana and oat smoothie
description: A filling drink-and-go breakfast of kefir, banana, oats and a spoon of peanut butter.

steps.text: Peel the bananas and break them into pieces.
steps.tip: Frozen banana pieces make it thick and cold, like a milkshake.

steps: Put the bananas, kefir, oats, peanut butter and cinnamon in a blender.

steps.text: Blend for about a minute until completely smooth.
steps.tip: Too thick? Add a splash of milk or water and blend again.

steps.text: Pour into glasses and drink straight away, or keep in a closed jar in the fridge until the morning.
steps.tip: It thickens overnight as the oats soak. Shake or stir before drinking.

title: Zucchini fritaja
description: Coastal-style fritaja: eggs baked slowly with zucchini, onion and a little cheese.
steps: Slice the zucchini into thin rounds and the onion into thin half moons.

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a non-stick frying pan with a lid on medium heat. Fry the onion and zucchini for 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft and golden.
steps.tip: Golden zucchini have the most flavour. Spread them out so they brown instead of steaming.

steps: Meanwhile beat the eggs with the salt and the grated parmesan.

steps.text: Spread the vegetables evenly, pour over the eggs and turn the heat to low. Cover and cook for 8 minutes, until the top is almost set.
steps.tip: Do not stir. Run a spatula around the edge after a few minutes so it does not stick.

steps.text: Put a large plate over the pan and turn it over quickly so the fritaja lands on the plate. Slide it back into the pan, cooked side up, and cook 2 minutes more.
steps.tip: Not confident flipping? If your pan handle can go in the oven, finish it under the grill for a couple of minutes instead.

steps.text: Cut into wedges and serve warm or cold with bread.
steps.tip: Cold wedges make a good packed lunch the next day.

title: Tofu scramble on toast
description: Crumbled tofu fried with turmeric, onion, pepper and spinach. A plant-based scrambled egg.

steps.text: Drain the tofu and pat it dry with kitchen paper. Chop the onion and pepper.
steps.tip: Firm tofu works best. The drier it is, the better it browns.

steps: Heat the olive oil in a frying pan on medium heat and fry the onion and pepper for 4 minutes until soft.

steps.text: Crumble the tofu into the pan with your fingers into egg-sized pieces and smaller. Add the turmeric and salt and fry for 4 minutes, stirring now and then, until golden in places.
steps.tip: Turmeric gives the yellow egg colour. A pinch of black pepper helps it taste more savoury.

steps: Stir in the spinach until it wilts. Meanwhile toast the bread.
Pile the scramble onto the toast and serve straight away.

title: Garlic mushrooms and egg on toast
description: Buttery garlic mushrooms with parsley on toast, topped with a poached or fried egg.

steps.text: Wipe the mushrooms clean and slice them. Chop the garlic and parsley.
steps.tip: Do not wash mushrooms under the tap. They soak up water and then will not brown.

steps: Melt the butter in a large frying pan on high heat. Add the mushrooms in one layer and leave them for a moment before stirring.

steps.text: Fry for 6 minutes, stirring now and then, until golden brown and their juice has cooked away. Add the garlic, parsley and a pinch of salt at the end and stir for a few seconds.
steps.tip: Mushrooms first let out water, then brown. Salt them at the end, or they let out water too early and stew.

steps: Meanwhile fry the eggs in a second pan for 3 to 4 minutes and toast the bread.
Pile the mushrooms on the toast and put an egg on top.

title: Yogurt and muesli parfait
description: Layers of yogurt, muesli and fruit in a glass. Make two the night before.
steps: Peel the mandarins and separate them into segments. Thaw the berries a little, or use them half frozen.

steps.text: In two glasses, layer a spoon of yogurt, then muesli, then fruit, and repeat until everything is used, finishing with fruit on top.
steps.tip: Glasses show off the layers, but any bowl works.

steps.text: Eat straight away.
steps.tip: For the next morning, layer only the yogurt and fruit and keep the muesli in a separate box so it stays crunchy.

title: Millet porridge with pear and almonds
description: Creamy millet cooked in milk with vanilla, topped with soft pear and toasted almonds.

steps.text: Put the millet in a sieve and rinse it well under hot water.
steps.tip: Rinsing takes away the slightly bitter taste millet can have.

steps: Put the millet, milk and vanilla sugar in a small pot and bring to a simmer.

steps.text: Turn the heat to low and cook for 18 minutes, stirring often, until the millet is soft and creamy.
steps.tip: Add a splash of milk or water if it gets too thick before the millet is soft.

steps: Meanwhile dice the pear and chop the almonds. Stir the pear in for the last few minutes of cooking.
Spoon into bowls and top with the almonds.

title: Warm quinoa breakfast bowl
description: Quinoa cooked in milk with cinnamon, topped with banana, peanut butter and seeds.

steps.text: Rinse the quinoa in a fine sieve under cold water.
steps.tip: Rinsing removes the bitter coating on the seeds.

steps: Put it in a small pot with the milk and cinnamon and bring to a simmer.

steps.text: Cover and cook on low for 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until the seeds are soft and you can see little curly tails.
steps.tip: If it dries out before it is soft, add a splash of milk.

steps: Spoon into bowls and top with sliced banana, a spoon of peanut butter and the sunflower seeds.

title: Smoked salmon on rye with cream cheese
description: Dark rye bread with cream cheese, smoked salmon, cucumber and a squeeze of lemon.
steps: Toast the rye bread lightly if you like. Slice the cucumber very thinly.
Spread the bread with the cream cheese, right to the edges.

steps.text: Lay the salmon on top in loose folds, then add the cucumber slices.
steps.tip: Folding the salmon loosely makes it look generous and is easier to bite.

steps: Sprinkle with dill and finish with a squeeze of lemon and a little black pepper.

title: Turkish eggs with garlic yogurt
description: Poached eggs on garlicky yogurt with paprika butter, eaten with warm bread.

steps.text: Take the yogurt out of the fridge. Grate the garlic finely, mix it into the yogurt with a pinch of salt and spread it on two plates.
steps.tip: Yogurt at room temperature is nicer under warm eggs, so leave it out while you do the rest.

steps: Fill a medium pot with water about 8 cm deep and bring it to a gentle simmer, with small bubbles only. Crack each egg into its own cup.

steps.text: Stir the water to make a gentle whirl and slide in the eggs one by one, close to the surface. Cook for 3 minutes.
steps.tip: Very fresh eggs keep their shape best. They are done when the whites are set and the yolk wobbles when you lift an egg with a slotted spoon.

steps.text: Meanwhile melt the butter in a small pan on low heat. Take it off the heat and stir in the paprika and chili flakes.
steps.tip: Paprika burns quickly. Stirring it in off the heat turns the butter red without making it bitter.

steps: Lift the eggs out with a slotted spoon, let the water drip off and set them on the yogurt. Pour the red butter over and serve with toasted bread.

title: Baked eggs with spinach and feta
description: Eggs baked in a dish over garlicky spinach and tomatoes with crumbled feta.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Chop the garlic and dice the tomato.

steps.text: Heat the oil in an ovenproof frying pan on medium. Add the garlic and spinach and stir until wilted, about 2 minutes.
steps.tip: No ovenproof pan? Wilt the spinach in any pan, then spread it in a small baking dish.

steps: Spread the spinach out and scatter over the tomato. Make {4} hollows and crack an egg into each. Crumble the feta around the eggs.

steps.text: Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks are still soft.
steps.tip: The eggs keep cooking in the hot pan, so take it out when the whites are just set.

steps: Serve straight from the pan with bread or toast for dipping.

title: Cottage cheese pancakes
description: Soft little pancakes made with fresh cottage cheese, eggs and a little flour, served with jam.

steps.text: Put the cottage cheese, eggs, flour and sugar in a bowl and mix with a fork into a thick batter.
steps.tip: It should hold its shape on a spoon. If it is runny, add a spoon of flour.

steps: Heat a little of the oil in a non-stick frying pan on medium heat.

steps.text: Drop in heaped spoonfuls of batter and flatten them a little into thick pancakes about the size of your palm. Fry for 2 to 3 minutes until golden underneath.
steps.tip: Leave them alone until the edges look set. They are soft and break if you flip them too early.

steps.text: Flip carefully with a spatula and fry the other side for 2 to 3 minutes. Repeat with the rest of the batter, adding a little oil each time.
steps.tip: Turn the heat down a little if they brown before the middle is cooked.

steps: Serve warm with the jam.
